def: Tiberias, the name of a town and a lake in Palestine

occurrences.text: (Howbeit there came other boats from Tiberias nigh unto the place where they did eat bread, after that the Lord had given thanks:)
After these things Jesus shewed himself again to the disciples at the sea of Tiberias; and on this wise shewed he himself.

source: Strong's Exhaustive Concordance (1890) and Concise Dictionaries (1894), public domain; JSON by Open Scriptures (CC BY-SA).
